own_evidence_understanding.validation_table: The first five checks establish matched material, an executed local program, a specific mechanism, the recorded parameter update and matching file bytes. The held-out task row answers a separate capability question. Passing all structural/runtime checks cannot replace task scoring.
own_evidence_understanding.splits_and_selection: Training changes weights; validation compares recipes/candidates; final test assesses the fixed selected configuration. Using final-test errors to tune a new version requires a new unseen final test. The cited 1,039/2,077-step LoRA candidates are compared with base using the same ASR; photo gains alone do not compensate for lost chat retention or incomplete endings.
own_evidence_understanding.speech_control: A correct source transcript sent to the same chat model tests answering separately from recognition. The raw ASR route then tests the combined route. In the small example, losing the one negation changes the request despite only 1/9 = 11.1% CER. Restoring it gives 0 edits and 0% CER but does not prove the assistant follows the request.
own_evidence_understanding.smoke_numbers: 31,584 is the cited small-model parameter count; 40 is the backup/retrieval point; 80 is the end for resumed and uninterrupted routes; recorded maximum weight difference 0 compares that pair of final states. These are cited earlier CUDA/HF-flow results. I did not recreate them and they are not natural-photo or speech scores.
own_evidence_understanding.data_and_model_counts: The assigned publishing page deliberately derives Notebook count from the current subsection catalog. The observed local preview build-info names 266 lessons, executed_cpu_outputs=true, builder Zensical 0.0.67, and reading_time_pages=0/reading_time_complete=false; this is preview metadata, not a completed release or my Notebook execution. The necessary 20.13 card names a 2,127,532,032-parameter Qwen graph/image-language base and a separate 808,878,080-parameter Whisper speech recognizer, no activated LoRA. The card distinguishes 42 descriptions and 84 questions sharing 42 photos, OCR presence/copy/order tasks with overlapping material, 13 text chats and two four-question speech-chat routes. Its generated-answer denominators sum to 42+84+18+10+3+13+4+4=178; 171 normal endings plus 7 truncations also sum to 178. Twenty-two transcription clips are assessed with character-error rates, not added as another 22 generated chat answers. Shared pictures/questions make the 178 responses correlated, not 178 independent situations. All card scores/model counts are cited, not my inference run.

linked_exercise_assessment.20.8: Answered in my own terms: if correct transcripts already lose chat score, ASR alone cannot explain the failure; both chat routes must retain ability, so photo gains are insufficient.
linked_exercise_assessment.20.12: Negation repair was predicted and executed; CER becomes zero. A correctly heard request still needs a relevant, compliant, complete answer. No real audio or assistant was run.
linked_exercise_assessment.20.13: The identical-byte repair was predicted and executed; the comparison becomes true. Identical fingerprints identify the configured artifacts, not reliable answers. For an untested noisy spontaneous speech use, examples should preserve raw recordings/reference text, compare both answer routes on the same request/history and score both complete outputs; an output-only test would not suffice. No new scored evaluation or model experiment was run.

verdict_reason: Both complete documents are understandable in their stated learning/maintenance roles. The actual necessary destinations resolve the background and explain their claimed examples. I can reproduce the evidence boundaries and literal workflow in my own words, and no blocker remained after the full source/browser read.
